title: Anthropic's $380B Valuation: Second-Biggest Tech Raise Ever — 2026-02-15
description: Anthropic has clinched a staggering $380 billion valuation following a $30 billion funding round, marking the second-largest tech raise ever. This positions the AI systems company alongside industry giants like OpenAI and SpaceX as one of the largest IPO candidates.
